description_sq:
Ambienti eshte pjese e kompleksit Square 21, ndertuar se fundmi nga Arlis Construction.
Square 21 eshte pozicionuar buze rruges se Kavajes, shume prane me kryqezimin e 21 Dhjetorit.
Eshte nje nga komplekset me cilesore dhe me te preferuara ne Tirane.
Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 0, me akses hyrje-dalje nga brenda dhe jashte kompleksit.
Siperfaqe totale 197.7 m2, siperfaqe neto 179.2 m2.
Eshte i pershtatshem per Bar-Restorant, klinike dentare, Show-room.
Momentalisht eshte i dhene me qira (kontrate 4 vjecare).
Disponon certifikate pronesie.
title_en: For sale - Commercial premises at Square 21
description_en: The environment is part of the Square 21 complex, recently built by Arlis Construction. Square 21 is positioned on the edge of Kavaje street, very close to the intersection of 21 December. It is one of the highest quality and most popular complexes in Tirana. The environment is located on the 0th floor, with entrance-exit access from inside and outside the complex. Total area 197.7 m2, net area 179.2 m2. It is suitable for Bar-Restaurant, dental clinic, Show-room. It is currently rented (4-year contract). It has ownership certificates.
